facts.fact: The CIL's commissioners met in December 2024 and adopted a deliberation requiring prior free and informed consent before personal data goes to third parties.
facts.system: Commission de l'informatique et des libertes (CIL)

facts.fact: The CIL says it adopted a general deliberation on communication of personal data to third parties, with sanctions for breach; no decision on a controller.
facts.system: CIL deliberation on communication to third parties
